Who We Are

The Opportunity

We're hiring an Email & SMS Marketing Contractor to own the lifecycle messaging engine for a fast-growing direct-to-consumer cookware and home goods brand heading into its biggest selling season of the year. This is a hands-on, execution-heavy engagement — you'll audit and optimize the existing Klaviyo flows (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment), build new automations to close the gaps in the customer lifecycle, and run a disciplined testing program across subject lines, send times, content, offers, and flow logic. Holiday Readiness & Revenue Goals: Build a holiday-specific testing and optimization roadmap for August–December, proactively identify and fix automation gaps before peak traffic hits, and adjust segmentation, targeting, and messaging cadence to support repeat purchase rate and overall revenue goals.
Risk Flagging: Surface deliverability issues, list fatigue, and flow bottlenecks with enough lead time to fix them before key selling periods such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holiday shipping deadlines.
Reporting & Collaboration: Report weekly on test results, flow performance, and SMS program metrics, and partner with creative/design and merchandising teams to keep content and offers aligned with the promotional calendar.




What You Bring

Email Automation Expertise: Proven experience managing email marketing automation in Klaviyo or a similar ESP, with hands-on ownership of lifecycle flows end to end.
SMS Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Klaviyo SMS, Attentive, or Postscript.
Testing & Analytics: A strong understanding of A/B testing methodology and how to read statistical significance, plus an analytical mindset that's comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data to guide decisions.
Segmentation & Lifecycle Strategy: Experience with segmentation strategy and lifecycle marketing, and familiarity with repeat rate, LTV, and revenue-per-recipient as success metrics.

About the job

Are you an ambitious engineer ready to take on meaningful challenges and accelerate your growth? We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our 250+ person Product & Engineering organization at Smartly.

Our engineering team builds the technology that powers creative automation for some of the world’s largest brands. We enable them to turn a single idea into high-performing, global campaigns by delivering fast, scalable, and intuitive creative tools used at massive scale. Increasingly, we’re also building AI-driven workflows that help customers generate, adapt, and optimize creatives in smarter ways.

As a frontend engineer, you’ll tackle complex challenges across performance, scalability, and user experience. You’ll build responsive, reliable interfaces that make sophisticated capabilities feel simple and delightful. Work is done closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to craft features that our customers will genuinely love and depend on.

We’re focused on React and TypeScript as our core frontend stack, and continuously evolve how we use them to build performant, maintainable, and scalable products. We care deeply about engineering craftsmanship, product quality, and continuous improvement, always looking for better ways to build, simplify, and scale.

Check out our Engineering at Smartly site to learn how our engineering and product development work.

Take an end-to-end responsibility for complex projects from design to deployment.
Find the smallest possible increments to deliver value to our customers as quickly as possible.
Partner closely with Product and UX to dissect complex requirements into well-designed and well-executed software.
Lead technical design decisions and tradeoffs, balancing long-term architecture with immediate product needs.
Be a core contributor to our Engineering Group, ensuring our frontend and core packages remain performant and scalable.
Act as a mentor and technical guide, elevating the team through constructive code reviews and sharing your expertise.
Drive projects forward independently and proactively dispatching roadblocks.


What We’re Looking For:


Minimum of 6 years of experience in building robust, complex web applications with a mastery of frontend development.
Expertise in React and TypeScript, with a deep understanding of state management and performance optimization.
Proven ability to drive projects independently, showing persistence and autonomy in the face of technical hurdles.
Ambition and eagerness to excel and commitment to continuous growth
Excellent spoken and written communication skills in English
Strong analytical skills to translate a broad product vision into actionable technical tasks.
Motivation for solving customers' problems and delivering value to customers at a fast pace
Ability to work on-site at our Mexico City office 3 days per week


Smartly is committed to being the best place to work for growth-minded individuals to thrive - explore more in our Culture Handbook!

Meet the Team Lead: Gain deeper insights into your future team.

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. description:
About the job

¿Te gustaría contribuir a la mejora del mundo educativo y formar parte de una de las compañías EdTech más innovadoras y de mayor crecimiento internacional?

BlinkLearning es una empresa de tecnología educativa con más de 4 millones de usuarios activos en más de 50 países. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la educación a través del buen uso de la tecnología y la innovación, facilitando herramientas que ayuden a equipos directivos y docentes a preparar a sus alumnos para los retos del futuro en un entorno en constante cambio.

🚀 Buscamos: Director/a Comercial México | EdTech B2B – Sector Educativo K-12

 📍 Ciudad de México

Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo un/a Director/a Comercial para liderar la operación comercial en México, reportando directamente a la Dirección Comercial Internacional.

Misión de la posición

Ejecutar y hacer crecer el plan de negocio del país mediante una gestión comercial rigurosa y basada en datos: liderar la adopción de soluciones de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a la educación, desarrollar nuevas verticales de negocio, fortalecer las alianzas estratégicas con editoriales educativas y consolidar la cartera actual.

Responsabilidades principales

▸ Gestión directa de cuentas institucionales de alto valor y cierre de acuerdos marco multi-colegio

 ▸ Desarrollo y consolidación de relaciones comerciales con editoriales del sector educativo

 ▸ Liderazgo, coaching y dirección de un equipo de 4 a 6 consultores comerciales senior, con disciplina de funnel y metodología de calificación rigurosa

 ▸ Responsabilidad sobre la estrategia comercial del país: segmentación, pricing, análisis de mercado y cumplimiento de objetivos

 ▸ Gestión y análisis sistemático de KPIs comerciales (actividad, conversión por etapa, resultados) con forecast riguroso y reporting periódico basado en datos

 ▸ Uso avanzado de CRM como herramienta central de gestión: calificación de oportunidades, trazabilidad del pipeline y toma de decisiones data-driven

 ▸ Generación de demanda institucional mediante eventos, campañas y posicionamiento de marca

Perfil requerido

✔ 8+ años de experiencia comercial B2B en el sector educativo K-12 en México, con al menos 3 años liderando equipos comerciales en una posición de gerencia o dirección comercial

 ✔ Uso avanzado y demostrable de CRM (gestión de pipeline, reporting, forecast, automatización de procesos comerciales)

 ✔ Capacidad de análisis de datos comerciales para la toma de decisiones: lectura de funnel, conversión, rentabilidad por cuenta y priorización de esfuerzos

 ✔ Perfil metódico y orientado a proceso: disciplina de ejecución, seguimiento riguroso de KPIs y consistencia en la aplicación de metodología comercial

 ✔ Experiencia utilizando herramientas de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a la gestión comercial y/o comercializando soluciones de IA educativa

 ✔ Conocimiento profundo del ecosistema de instituciones educativas privadas de alto nivel, incluyendo redes congregacionales

 ✔ Red de contactos activa y demostrable con dueños, direcciones generales y direcciones académicas del sector

 ✔ Experiencia en venta consultiva de ciclo medio-largo con cuentas institucionales, idealmente en edtech, contenidos digitales o plataformas educativas

 ✔ Conocimiento del modelo de negocio editorial educativo

 ✔ Dominio de metodologías de calificación de oportunidades (BANT, MEDPICC, SPIN Selling, Challenger Sale)

 ✔ Disponibilidad para viajar de forma regular dentro del país

Lo que ofrecemos

Formar parte de una compañía EdTech internacional en pleno crecimiento, con un proyecto de país ya estructurado y basado en datos, producto diferencial en tecnología educativa e inteligencia artificial, y el respaldo de una organización consolidada con presencia activa en más de 50 países.

About the job

For Mexico Applicants:

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Only applications of candidates with Mexican citizenship will be evaluated for this role in compliance with the provisions of Article 7 of the Federal Labor Law.

For Buenos Aires Applicants:

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Mexico City, CDMX, Mexico; Buenos Aires, Argentina.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in the video, media, entertainment industry, as a YouTube creator or working with partners or creators.
Experience in an external-facing customer interaction role within customer support, sales, or relationship development.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience with project management using project execution frameworks.
Ability to manage basic negotiation, understanding key commercial terms and closing standard agreements.
Ability to interact comfortably with stakeholders at all levels of an organization, as well as influencing cross-functionally.
Ability to analyze data and insights and translate in an external-friendly, actionable way.
Effective problem-solving skills and proven track record of proactively improving processes.
Excellent communication, presentation, planning and time/pipeline management skills, with strong attention to detail.


About The Job

The YouTube Partner Program engages millions of content creators — a group that’s growing quickly, and will grow even faster in the coming years. The Scaled Partnerships team focuses on driving partner and product success at scale by acquiring, managing, and growing partners. The team spans acquisitions and partnerships to drive outcomes across all partner types and all verticals. The Partnerships team is responsible for managing creators and companies that have reached a certain threshold for strategic importance. Fast-paced, dynamic and proactive, our team goal is to responsibly grow creators and media companies at scale through enriching 1:1 and 1:many engagement, product activations, opportunities, and virtual and in-person workshops.

As a Strategic Partner Manager (SPM), you will manage a portfolio of YouTube creators identified as strategic to our business objectives. You will drive product adoption and optimization across YouTube’s platform priorities while also assessing creators’ needs and goals, crafting a plan to grow their channel, and delivering insights and strategy to enable their success on YouTube. You will deliver against partner performance metrics and core program Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to drive maximum impact.

In this role, you grow in a fast-paced environment, and you are building a working understanding of YouTube internal processes, products, and teams. You support your team in deepening relationships with key partners and creators, helping them optimize and adopt features, enabling YouTube to be successful. You are developing your skills in relationship-building, negotiation, project management, and collaboration, focusing on tasks that contribute to your team's and organization's goals.

Responsibilities


Establish scaled strategic relationships with partners through different engagement types.
Drive product adoption, optimization across YouTube priorities and support creators in their content, monetization and viewership goals.
Ensure your partner portfolio complies with YouTube’s Community Guidelines and M10N policies and support them in navigating YouTube’s support and operations teams.
Engage with and understand the latest features, policies, and platform improvements to help partners succeed.
Project manage initiatives to grow emerging creators, including workshops, events and other scaled initiatives.

title: Auxiliar contable
description:
About the job

Guadalajara, Jalisco · Presencial · Tiempo completo

Sueldo acorde a experiencia







SOBRE NOSOTROS




MM Estudio Interior es un despacho de diseño estratégico especializado en restaurantes y hospitalidad, fundado en 2011 en Guadalajara. Contamos con más de 100 proyectos entregados, +27,000 m² diseñados y presencia en 17 ciudades de México y Estados Unidos.







OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO




Registrar, controlar y dar seguimiento a las cuentas por cobrar y por pagar del estudio, asegurando que cada operación quede correctamente contabilizada en CONTPAQi, respaldada con su soporte fiscal válido y reflejada con exactitud en los reportes de flujo de efectivo.







PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES




· Captura de pólizas en CONTPAQi (ingresos, egresos y diario) con la afectación contable correcta por cuenta y por proyecto.

· Registro contable de facturación, pagos, anticipos, retenciones y provisiones.

· Emisión y seguimiento de CFDI 4.0, complementos de pago y cobranza a clientes.

· Validación, programación y ejecución de pagos a proveedores con expediente documental completo.

· Conciliaciones bancarias mensuales de las cuentas del estudio.

· Conciliación de auxiliares de clientes y proveedores contra saldos contables.

· Apoyo en la conciliación de IVA trasladado y acreditable.

· Integración del paquete mensual para el despacho contable externo.

· Control de antigüedad de saldos y seguimiento de cartera vencida.

· Actualización del dashboard de flujo de efectivo.







PERFIL REQUERIDO




Formación y experiencia

· Licenciatura en Contaduría Pública (titulado o pasante). Indispensable formación contable.

· 1 a 2 años de experiencia como auxiliar contable, con exposición real a registro de pólizas y cierre mensual.




Conocimiento contable (indispensable)

· Dominio de la partida doble y del catálogo de cuentas: saber a qué cuenta afecta cada movimiento y por qué.

· Registro de pólizas de ingresos, egresos y diario en CONTPAQi.

· Manejo de cuentas de balance y de resultados; provisiones, anticipos de clientes y pagos anticipados a proveedores.

· Conciliación de auxiliares contra balanza de comprobación.

· Comprensión de los estados financieros básicos y de cómo cada registro los impacta.




Conocimiento fiscal

· CFDI 4.0: emisión, complementos de pago, notas de crédito y cancelaciones.

· IVA 16%, IVA trasladado y acreditable.

· Retenciones de ISR e IVA por servicios profesionales y arrendamiento.

· Portal del SAT: descarga masiva de XML y verificación de comprobantes.




Herramientas

· CONTPAQi (indispensable). Se valora experiencia previa en Aspel o SAP.

· Excel intermedio–alto: tablas dinámicas, BUSCARV/BUSCARX, SUMAR.SI.CONJUNTO.




Competencias clave

· Criterio contable: ante un movimiento poco común, sabe razonar el registro correcto y sustentarlo, no solo copiar el asiento anterior.

· Pensamiento analítico: interpreta cifras, identifica patrones y explica el origen de una desviación, no únicamente la reporta.

· Resolución de problemas: investiga diferencias hasta su causa raíz y propone alternativas de solución.

· Atención al detalle y rigor documental.

· Adaptable y flexible ante diferentes situaciones.

· Comunicación cordial y firme con clientes y proveedores.

· Discreción en el manejo de información financiera.




Deseable

· Experiencia en despachos de diseño, arquitectura, construcción, hospitalidad o retail.

· Experiencia en contabilidad por centro de costos o por proyecto.

· Inglés intermedio.







OFRECEMOS




· Sueldo 18,000 - 22,000 MXN, acorde a experiencia.

· Indicadores de desempeño definidos desde el ingreso.

· Integración a un equipo consolidado en el sector de diseño y hospitalidad.
